-- Migration for day trading tables
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS day_trading_signals (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  strategyName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  symbol VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  price INT NOT NULL,
  confidence INT NOT NULL,
  reasons TEXT,
  timestamp INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (userId) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS day_trading_positions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  strategyName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  symbol VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  quantity INT NOT NULL,
  openPrice INT NOT NULL,
  closePrice INT,
  stopLoss INT,
  takeProfit INT,
  openTime INT NOT NULL,
  closeTime INT,
  pnl INT,
  pnlPercent INT,
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (userId) REFERENCES users(id)
);
